newsitem.title: USA: Sifco says more certain of $100 mln sales.
newsitem.headline: Sifco says more certain of $100 mln sales.

text.p: Sifco Industries Inc said on Wednesday that after posting a 30 percent rise in net sales for the third fiscal quarter it could anticipate "with increased certainty" a $100-million sales year.
"We commented in our last quarterly report that our sales performance during the first half of 1997 could be leading us to our first $100 million sales year," said President Jeffrey Gotschall.
"We are able now to anticipate that accomplishment with increased certainty as we move into our final quarter of fiscal 1997," he added.
Sifco, a metalworking company, reported earnings per share of $0.38 for the quarter ended June 30, compared with $0.27 per share for the year-ago period.
